people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

translations.web: This thing became a sin; for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.
translations.bsb: And this thing became a sin; the people walked as far as Dan to worship before one of the calves.
translations.kjv: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
translations.asv: And this thing became a sin; for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
